content.comment_body: Hello, We have [company_name] PLCs that communicate with our Aveva Wonderware System Platform, allowing us to monitor and log historical data from analogue and digital inputs. Does anyone know if [product_name] controllers offer the same communication protocols as the [version_no] PLC family? The SIDirect DAServer currently supports certain [version_no] controllers. We are trying to determine whether we can purchase some [product_name] controllers and use them for data collection in our Wonderware historian, or whether we must stick to controllers based on [version_no].
If drivers are available for an [version_no], they should also work with a [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The user is seeking information about the compatibility of [product_name] controllers with the Aveva Wonderware System Platform, specifically regarding communication protocols. While feedback suggests that if existing drivers support one controller type, they might also support the other, full protocol compatibility is not confirmed.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes that [product_name] controllers will support protocols compatible with the Wonderware System Platform, similar to the [version_no] series, enabling seamless data collection and monitoring integration.
